=== WHAT P5's GATE MUST REPRODUCE ===
For each symbol, byte-for-byte: version, ecc, mask, and every matrix row.
coding.NewPlan(version, level, mask) takes the mask explicitly, so this is
a byte comparison and not a judgement call.

=== WHAT THIS FIXTURE DOES *NOT* ESTABLISH ===
It is ENCODE-ONLY. segno does not decode, so nothing here proves these
symbols reassemble -- that is exactly what S0's scan answers, off steel,
with a real scanner. A green run of this script is not a green gate.
